case.summary: The alert was triggered when the real-time model scored transaction 3553342 at 0.55, a $30.91 in-person purchase of product W in billing region 494 on 2016-12-18. The strongest findings are that the customer confirmed making the purchase when contacted and that, for product W transactions without an identity record in this score band, only 12 % were confirmed fraud in the July-October sample, indicating a low fraud likelihood despite the model score. The verdict is legitimate with a fraud probability of 3 %. The recommended actions are to allow the transaction, create a case record, and close it with no fraud finding.
